en: **Maps**: geographic areas, spatial relationships, locations, market territories, distances, distribution routes, points of interest, facilities, distribution of data; Geographic Information Systems (GIS)

**Illustrations, diagrams and photographs**: consider whether a diagram or photo is more effective; learn basic image-processing; ensure photos have communication value; be aware of copyrights and model permissions
**Infographics**: convey both data and concepts; independent, standalone documents; stylised charts or graphs; structured narrative
ms: **Peta**: kawasan geografi, hubungan ruang, lokasi, wilayah pasaran, jarak, laluan pengedaran, tempat menarik, kemudahan, taburan data; Sistem Maklumat Geografi (GIS)
**Ilustrasi, rajah dan gambar**: pertimbang rajah atau gambar lebih berkesan; belajar pemprosesan imej asas; pastikan gambar bernilai komunikasi; sedar hak cipta dan kebenaran model
**Infografik**: sampaikan data dan konsep; dokumen berdiri sendiri; carta atau graf bergaya; naratif berstruktur

blocks.en: Four decisions for integrating visuals with text
blocks.ms: Empat keputusan mengintegrasikan visual dengan teks

en: Maintaining balance between illustrations and words
Referring to visuals in the text
ms: Mengekalkan keseimbangan antara ilustrasi dan perkataan

en: Balance: avoid disrupting text flow with too many visuals; be aware of readers’ needs and backgrounds
Referencing: assign a reference number (table, exhibit, figure), use consistent numbering, emphasise the main point, refer in a summary manner
Placing: minimise back and forth; avoid bunching visuals; use software flexibility
Titles identify content and purpose; captions give extra detail; legends help complex graphics
ms: Keseimbangan: elak ganggu aliran teks dengan terlalu banyak visual; sedar keperluan dan latar pembaca
Rujukan: tetapkan nombor rujukan (jadual, pameran, rajah), nombor konsisten, tekankan poin utama, rujuk secara ringkas
Penempatan: kurangkan ulang-alik; elak menggumpal visual; guna fleksibiliti perisian
Tajuk kenal pasti kandungan dan tujuan; kapsyen beri butiran; legenda bantu grafik kompleks
